title: The Same Path, in a Window
fallback: This lesson is optional and nothing later depends on it. Lesson 00-07 draws the same path with the same arithmetic in a terminal and needs nothing installed, so a learner without Qt has already had the payoff and can go straight to phase 01. Run rcpp doctor for the install command when you do want the window.

artifact.note: one mapping that serves a terminal and a window, differing only by the shape of a cell
